datasheet_identity.title: S2AF THRU S2MF SURFACE MOUNT GENERAL PURPOSE RECTIFIER (SMAF Surface Mount General Purpose Rectifier)

extraction_notes: Family datasheet S2AF-S2MF; S2MF is the 1000 V member: VRRM = VDC = 1000 V and VRMS = 700 V (p. 1). IF(AV) = 2.0 A and IFSM = 50.0 A at 8.3 ms half-sine are common ratings.

Electrical table gives VF maximum 1.0 V at IF = 2.0 A, IR1 maximum 2.0 uA at VR = VDC and Ta = 25 degC, IR2 maximum 200 uA at Ta = 125 degC, and CJ typical 30 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz (p. 2). The high-temperature leakage row is recorded only as context and is not used as the 25 degC reverse-current input.

Fig.3 forward-voltage trace was digitized from the printed linear-voltage/log-current grid; plotted values are recorded in SI amperes. Fig.4 is a normalized reverse-characteristics plot and was not used as an absolute-voltage curve.
No reverse recovery time or measured avalanche/breakdown row is published. VRRM is an absolute maximum rating, not a measured breakdown voltage, so breakdown fields are null.
